slides.title: The silent nod.
slides.body: Racks it, walks off, writes it down. Screams internally for the rest of the day.

slides.title: "Was that depth?"
slides.body: Hit the number. Immediately needs three witnesses and a slow-motion replay.

slides.title: Didn't film it.
slides.body: Best lift of their life. Phone face down on the box. Will describe it for a week.

slides.title: Already in the group chat.
slides.body: Chalk still on their hands. Message sent before the bar stopped rolling.

slides.title: "It was only 2.5kg."
slides.body: Says it's nothing. Has told four people. You're the fifth.

slides.title: Loading another 2.5kg.
slides.body: Coach says that's enough for today. The plates are already on the bar.
